design_rationale:
WORKLOG — task 0 of savings_withdrawals_interest_and_transfers (category savings, Piedmont Crescent Bank).

STEP 0 — DRAW AND ASSET LEDGER.
scripts/draw_counts.py env/regional_retail_bank/tasks/savings_withdrawals_interest_and_transfers --tasks 2 printed:
  {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 5, 6]}
  {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}
Task 0 is therefore a tree of four problems and its computations must carry the multiset {5, 5, 6, 6} factors.
Assignment: savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction 6, savings_ext_relationship_bonus_correction 5,
savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit 5, savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount 6.
Occupied before this task: nothing (this is the first task of the difficulty). Claimed here: the four policies above
and the four tools post_promotional_interest_correction_acb0ec5b, post_relationship_bonus_correction_5bb15040,
credit_savings_courtesy_refund_0ed102a0 and set_savings_standing_transfer_55216172. Left for task 1: the closure side
of the charter — savings_close and savings_withdrawal as a subject (the closing payout the owner confirms) and the
accrued interest a closure credits — which shares no policy, no tool and no computed parameter with this task, and
whose draw is a tree of two problems.

STEP 0 — DESIGN THESIS.
Surface goal: "set up a standing monthly transfer from my checking into the money market account, on the 5th, at
whatever the qualifying amount is". Scored core parameter: transfer_amount, which is fixed by the qualifying
shortfall between the account's posted balance and its balance target. Nothing the customer says names that amount,
and no single lookup gives it: the balance target is raised by a checking condition, the shortfall is reduced by the
deposits of the last month within a ceiling, the spread period is shortened by card use, the instalment is paced by
the withdrawal count, rounded by the account's age and capped by the withdrawals of the last month. Behind it sit
three problems the customer never mentions, all of which change the posted balance the shortfall is measured from.
Chain: standing transfer <- relationship bonus correction <- promotional interest correction, with the courtesy
credit hanging off the standing transfer in parallel. Depth: three hops from the surface goal to the promotional
basis. Breadth: four policies, three cross-category products (checking, card, certificate), nine history windows
(whole ledger, one calendar month, three calendar months, twelve calendar months, by event type, by channel, by fee
code and by interest component) and the negative space that no excess withdrawal fee is owed because every cycle
stays inside the tier's allowance of six counted withdrawals.

STEP 0 — BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
Write subject savings_interest_credit (steps 10 and 12). Governing base policies:
 - savings_agg_relationship_bonus_allocation, gate qualifying_checking (authorization, system_record, pre_action,
   correlation checking_accounts.customer_id -> action arg customer_id). Satisfied: the owner holds Interest
   Checking, active, and Interest Checking is listed in the Money Market Account's relationship_bonus_checking_tiers
   ([Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking]). Negative case: had the owner held only Everyday
   Checking, the tier would not be listed and no relationship bonus could be paid at all.
 - savings_evt_interest, no structured eligibility, carried as policy_scope; its clause that a correction for
   interest under-credited in a past cycle "is written as a separate row with adjustment_reason bank_error for the
   same statement_cycle and component, for the difference only" is inherited and is exactly what both tools write.
 - savings_evt_bonus_interest, gate promo_period (time). anchor_event "the account was opened"; anchor_source
   savings_accounts.opened_date = 2026-04-20; relation not_after; duration_source variants.promo_duration_months = 6
   for the Money Market Account; unit calendar_months; counting_rule "Count calendar months from opened_date; a day
   is within the promotional period when it is on or before opened_date plus promo_duration_months calendar months,
   which is the recorded promo_end_date."; boundary inclusive. promo_end_date is recorded as 2026-10-20. At
   frozen_time 2026-09-16 the account is inside the period. Just-fails case: 2026-10-21; just-passes case:
   2026-10-20 itself, because the boundary is inclusive.
Write subject savings_fee_refund (step 14). Governing: savings_evt_fee_refund, five gates, all inherited:
 eligible_fee_code (monthly_maintenance is in courtesy_eligible_fee_codes); courtesy_window (time: the fee posted
 2026-08-28, day 19 of the tier's 60; just-fails 2026-07-17, just-passes 2026-07-18); courtesy_limit (the owner has
 no savings courtesy refund in the rolling 365 days, below the tier's limit of 2); account_open (status active);
 refund_once (no savings_fee_refund row carries that fee as its source item). None of them is retired: the policy's
 single overwrite quotes only the sentence "A fee is refunded in full, never in part, as one savings_fee_refund row
 whose source_item_id is the fee row.", which is none of the five gate conditions.
Write subject savings_set_automatic_transfer (step 16). Governing: savings_evt_automatic_transfer, two gates:
 funding_account_owned_active (checking account 8823 belongs to the same customer and is active) and minimum_amount
 (295.00 is at or above the Money Market Account's automatic_transfer_min_amount of 100.00). Boundary: an amount of
 99.99 would fail; the compute's floor MX(P('automatic_transfer_min_amount'), rounded_instalment) makes a smaller
 figure impossible by construction.

STEP 0 — BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD.
Target objects: the single Money Market Account ab0c9bef (last four 6317) for all four writes, and for the courtesy
credit the single fee entry it is booked against. Correlation key for the credit: savings_transactions.savings_txn_id
of the most recently posted monthly maintenance fee, 2026-08-28. Rows included in the refundable pool: the three
monthly maintenance fees (2026-06-28, 2026-07-28, 2026-08-28) and the five paper statement fees (2026-04-28 through
2026-08-28). Rows excluded: nothing, because the tier's pool tier reaches every periodic fee of the twelve months;
the withdrawals, deposits and interest credits are not fees and carry fee_code none. No reversal, refund or
adjustment exists on the account, so nothing is already settled and the refund_once gate is clear. The two interest
corrections are correlated to their cycle by statement_cycle 2026-08 and to their component by interest_component,
which is exactly the grain the base charter declares for savings_interest_credit ("One row per account, statement
cycle, interest component and adjustment ground").

STEP 0 — PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount (the problem the customer's request points at; its target tool is
owner=user, so the customer's own write is in the tree).
Edges:
 1. savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount <- savings_ext_relationship_bonus_correction. kind value_input, gate the
    compute binding posted_balance, form state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule:
    "The qualifying recurring amount is worked out only after the account's posted balance carries the relationship
    bonus owed for every closed statement cycle." Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after"; (2)
    the side it waits on is a record-visible state — a relationship bonus entry standing on the account for every
    closed cycle, named in the words the ledger uses; (3) it names no tool, no policy id and no code token; (4) it is
    a hard requirement ("only after") over the closed cycles, exactly the scope of the edge's condition. Exactly one
    write of this difficulty brings that state about: post_relationship_bonus_correction_5bb15040 is the only action
    that books a relationship bonus credit, the promotional correction books interest_component promotional and the
    courtesy credit books a fee refund. Derivation: the sentence says the posted balance must carry the relationship
    bonus owed for every closed cycle; the records show 0.20 and 0.27 credited for 2026-07 and 2026-08 while the
    bonus policy's own rule computes 4.70 for the closed cycle on a basis of 1,879.28; so a bonus credit is still
    owed, and the only rule whose write books one is the relationship bonus correction. Resolving action:
    post_relationship_bonus_correction_5bb15040, owner agent. Unmet at the opening: savings_transactions row
    613c09e0 carries amount 0.27 and interest_component relationship_bonus, and savings_accounts.current_balance is
    1823.78.
 2. savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount <- savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit. kind value_input, gate
    posted_balance, form state. Sentence: "Before the qualifying recurring amount is fixed, the courtesy credit owed
    against the periodic fees standing on the account must already appear in its posted balance." Four-point test:
    (1) "Before"; (2) a record-visible state — a courtesy credit entry standing against the account's periodic fees;
    (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) a hard requirement ("must") over the periodic fees standing on the account,
    the same scope as the condition. Exactly one write brings it about: credit_savings_courtesy_refund_0ed102a0 is
    the only action that books a savings fee refund. Derivation: the ledger carries 46.00 of periodic fees and no
    fee refund row at all, so no courtesy credit stands; the only rule whose write books one is the periodic fee
    courtesy credit. Owner agent. Unmet at the opening: savings_transactions row 0065fbbe has fee_code
    monthly_maintenance and amount 12.0, and the ledger holds no savings_fee_refund row.
 3. savings_ext_relationship_bonus_correction <- savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction. kind value_input, gate
    the compute binding bonus_ledger_basis, form state. Sentence: "The relationship bonus owed for a closed statement
    cycle is settled only after the promotional interest due on that cycle's new money stands credited on the
    account." Four-point test: (1) "only after"; (2) a record-visible state — a promotional interest credit standing
    on the account for that cycle; (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) hard, and scoped to the closed cycle's new
    money exactly as the condition is. Exactly one write brings it about:
    post_promotional_interest_correction_acb0ec5b is the only action that books a promotional interest credit.
    Derivation: the records show 1.85 credited as promotional for cycle 2026-08 while the promotional policy's own
    rule computes 14.00 owed on a promotional basis of 2,025.00; the promotional interest due therefore does not
    stand credited, and only the promotional interest correction books it. Owner agent. Unmet at the opening:
    savings_transactions row 04e4828a carries amount 1.85, interest_component promotional, statement_cycle 2026-08.
Topological order: promotional interest correction, relationship bonus correction, periodic fee courtesy credit,
standing transfer amount. Parallel edges: the courtesy credit is free to move relative to the two interest problems
and the terminal state is identical either way (see prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness). Deletion sensitivity,
from the Step 5 run: skipping the relationship bonus correction moves transfer_amount from 295.00 to 297.00;
skipping the courtesy credit moves it from 295.00 to 320.00; skipping the promotional correction moves bonus_amount
from 4.23 to 4.20.

STEP 1 — POLICIES AND THE FACTOR CARD.
Claimed base lineage and overwrites are listed in the charter. Two overwrites are declared on savings_evt_interest
(both corrections replace the daily-accrual sentence with their own stated basis), one on savings_evt_bonus_interest
(the promotional portion sentence), one on savings_agg_relationship_bonus_allocation (the daily combined-cap
allocation sentence) and two on savings_evt_fee_refund (refund in full, and the courtesy window clause, which the
consolidated credit tests once against the fee entry it is booked against). Every other base clause of those
policies is inherited, including the four remaining courtesy gates, the promotional period gate and the qualifying
checking gate. The
standing transfer policy overwrites nothing: base fixes only the ownership, status and minimum of the instruction,
and the extended policy adds how the amount is chosen, which base never states.
Factor card (tier taken, evidence, baseline reading, figure under the baseline; figures from the Step 5 run):
 savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction, result 9.50, baseline of the whole computation 0.00:
  promotional_yield_step (parameter, cross-difficulty card): four card purchases in the three calendar months
   (2026-07-03, 2026-08-02, 2026-08-21, 2026-09-08 — the 2026-06-12 purchase is the near miss, one month outside)
   and a basis of 2,025.00 -> 4.10 percent; baseline P('promo_new_money_apy') = 3.50 -> 7.50.
  new_money_window_convention (method, cross-difficulty checking): 7,200.00 of payroll direct deposits on checking
   8823 and 2,800.00 of one-month new money -> the one-month figure grossed up by three, 8,400.00; baseline
   new_money_three_month = 13,300.00 -> 43.50.

   in the window -> half the withdrawals offset, 6,375.00; baseline withdrawals_three_month = 12,750.00 -> 0.00.

   K('span_standard') = 31 -> 2.50.

   baseline RND(raw_shortfall, 2) = 14.10 -> 9.60.

   months deducted, 4.50; baseline credited_promotional_one_month = 1.85 -> 12.15.

  bonus_rate_lift (parameter, cross-difficulty checking): ledger balance 8,450.00 and direct deposits 7,200.00 ->
   1.00 percent; baseline 0.15 percent -> 0.23.
  bonus_basis_netting (method, cross-difficulty card): card balance owed 1,240.55 and card payments 1,250.00 -> no
   further reduction of the bonus ledger basis, so the basis is 1,879.28; baseline further reduces it by the

  bonus_review_span (parameter): three deposits, four months open -> 90 days; baseline 31 -> 1.15.

  refundable_pool_width (method, cross-difficulty card): five card purchases in twelve months and 18,400 points ->
   pool 46.00; baseline maintenance_fees_one_month = 12.00 -> 11.00.
  courtesy_allowance_width (parameter, cross-difficulty checking): Interest Checking allows two courtesy refunds and
   no checking courtesy refund in the twelve months (the 2025-06-10 one is the near miss) -> allowance count 4;
   baseline P('courtesy_refund_limit_365d') = 2 -> 24.00.
  goodwill_share_step (parameter): eight fee entries in twelve months, four months open -> nine tenths; baseline one
   half -> 23.00.
  courtesy_credit_rounding (method): four deposits in twelve months -> rounded half up to the whole dollar, 41.00;
   baseline RND to the cent 41.40 -> 41.40.
  binding_ceiling_choice (method): five withdrawals in twelve months -> only the allowance amount of 48.00 binds;
   baseline the lesser of allowance and the 24.00 ceiling -> 24.00.
 savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount, result 295.00, baseline 155.37:
  balance_target_cushion (parameter, cross-difficulty checking): 8,450.00 and 7,200.00 -> target 2,750.00; baseline
   P('waiver_min_daily_balance') = 2,500.00 -> 138.00.
  recent_deposit_offset (method): 2,800.00 of deposits in the one calendar month -> shortfall reduced by 400.00;
   baseline no offset -> 545.00.
  spread_period_length (parameter, cross-difficulty card): four purchases in three months and 18,400 points -> two
   months; baseline four months -> 147.00.
  instalment_pacing (method): three withdrawals in three months -> quotient times 1.25 -> 294.6812; baseline the
   plain quotient -> 236.00.
  instalment_rounding (method): four whole months open -> rounded half up to the whole dollar, 295.00; baseline
   rounded to the cent 294.68 -> 294.68.

Every computation carries at least two parameter factors, at least two method factors, at least two multi-source
factors (each tier beyond the fall-through joins two conditions over distinct records by and) and at least two
cross-difficulty factors whose evidence is seeded: checking account 8823 with its payroll deposits and its 2025
courtesy refund, card 4409 with its five purchases, two payments and 18,400 points, and certificate 4471 with its
18,500.00 principal. No factor reads a field that names its own outcome; the schema carries no such stamp on these
tables.

STEP 1 — RULE AND COMPUTE, BOTH WAYS.
Forward: every binding that reads the world or makes a choice has a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis, and the
sensitive words line up — "three calendar months" against within_months=3, "the one calendar month ending on" against
within_months=1, "the twelve calendar months" against within_months=12, "other than internal transfers and automatic
transfers" against the channel filters, "no more than the tier's promotional balance cap" against MN, "taken as no
less than zero" against MX, "rounded half up to the cent" against RND(x, 2), "rounded half up to the whole dollar"
against RND(x + 0.5, 0), "truncated to the dime" against float(int(x * 10.0)) / 10.0 and "the lesser of" against MN.
Reverse: each rule sentence carrying a quantity, window, filter, branch, cap, ordering or rounding semantic is
claimed by a binding. The acting base is pinned in prose wherever it could be read two ways — the bonus cap "is
applied to the basis after that netting, never before it", the standing transfer's ceiling acts on the floored
instalment and not on the quotient, and the courtesy credit's ceiling acts on the rounded credit and not on the pool.

STEP 2 — TOOL CARDS.
post_promotional_interest_correction_acb0ec5b: owner agent, rw write; user the representative; target object the
money market account; one call creates one savings_transactions row with event_type savings_interest_credit,
interest_component promotional, adjustment_reason bank_error, the statement cycle given and the amount given, and
re-derives current_balance from the ledger; observable as a new promotional interest line and a higher balance;
receipt carries the entry reference, the amount, the cycle and the new balance.
post_relationship_bonus_correction_5bb15040: identical shape with interest_component relationship_bonus.
credit_savings_courtesy_refund_0ed102a0: creates a savings_fee_refund row carrying the fee code copied from the fee
entry it is booked against, adjustment_reason courtesy_waiver, and re-derives current_balance; receipt carries the
credit reference, the amount, the fee entry and the new balance.
set_savings_standing_transfer_55216172: owner user, rw write; one ctx.update writes automatic_transfer_amount,
automatic_transfer_day and funding_checking_account_id onto the savings account; receipt repeats all three. No tool
validates a prerequisite, computes an amount, aggregates history or refuses on a policy ground.
Gate run: check_task_tools.py returned TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK.

STEP 3 — THE WORLD, AND WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW EXISTS.
The opening deposit of 30,000.00 on 2026-04-20 is what qualified the promotional rate at all (promo_min_new_money is
25,000.00 inside a 30-day funding window) and sets the account's age; delete it and the promotional period has no
ground. The two large outflows (18,500.00 to the certificate on 2026-05-06, 10,200.00 to checking on 2026-06-03) are
what took the balance below the tier's 2,500.00 minimum daily balance, which is why the maintenance fees from the
June cycle on are correctly assessed and why the standing transfer has a shortfall to close; delete them and both the
courtesy credit and the transfer amount collapse. The three recent deposits and three recent withdrawals are the
three-month and one-month windows the promotional basis, the pacing, the deposit offset and the ceiling all read;
delete any one and a tier moves. The interest rows are the already-credited amounts both corrections deduct, and
their thinness against the basis is the defect being corrected. The fee rows are the courtesy credit's pool and the
counts behind two rounding and day-count conventions. Cross-category: checking 8823 carries the ledger balance and
the payroll deposits three factors read, plus a 2025-06-10 courtesy refund planted as a near miss for the twelve
month window; card 4409 carries four purchases inside three months, a fifth on 2026-06-12 planted as a near miss for
the three-month window but counted in the twelve-month window, two payments and 18,400 points; certificate 4471
carries the principal the withdrawal offset reads. Automatic-clause check: no cycle reaches the tier's allowance of
six counted withdrawals (the cycles hold at most one counted withdrawal each, and the two internal transfers are not
a counted channel for this tier), so no excess withdrawal fee is owed anywhere; the account is active and its last
customer activity was 2026-09-11, far inside the 24-month dormancy period, so no dormancy fee is owed; no wire
posted, so no wire fee is owed; the account is past its 90-day early closure window and nothing is being closed.
No cache field is used as a trap in this task: savings_accounts.current_balance is exactly the ledger sum at the
opening (1,823.78) and each tool re-derives it, so the displayed balance and the ledger never disagree.
Prerequisite falsification, row by row: 04e4828a (promotional 1.85 for 2026-08) makes the promotional interest due
on the closed cycle's new money not stand credited; 613c09e0 (relationship bonus 0.27 for 2026-08) makes the bonus
owed for the closed cycle not stand credited; and the complete absence of any savings_fee_refund row against
0065fbbe and its seven sibling fee rows makes the courtesy credit not appear in the posted balance. Delete any of
those facts — credit the full amounts, or plant a courtesy refund — and the corresponding edge lapses.

STEP 4 — THE PERSONA.
Dana Ferrell is written as a cheerful, disorganised small-business owner who talks in round numbers. She volunteers
only the surface goal (a standing monthly transfer from checking into the money market account), the day she wants
it to run, that she wants it done today rather than quoted, and that the amount is for the bank to work out. Her
identifying details come one at a time and only when asked, in a stated order. Her passive reactions are woven into
the narration rather than scripted: she agrees to whatever must be put right without asking what it is, she accepts
any figure read to her because she has no paperwork, she runs the standing instruction herself once it is handed
over and says it is on record, and she closes when told the transfer is recorded. She has one explicit cannot-answer
branch (the date she first banked with Piedmont Crescent) with the definite consequence that the agent reads it off
the profile. She never names an amount, never mentions interest, fees, refunds or bonuses, and never corrects.

STEP 5 — VERIFICATION CODE AND ITS OUTPUT.
The verification is the gate itself: skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py replays the gold writes
with the real tools onto the seeded DB, evaluates each policy's compute on the snapshot taken just before its own
step, and compares with expected and with the gold argument. The authoring run (the same evaluator, driven from the
task's own evaluation_criteria) printed, in topological order:
  savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction  result=9.5    baseline_all=0.0     touched=20 branches=19
  savings_ext_relationship_bonus_correction    result=4.23   baseline_all=0.0     touched=28 branches=22
  savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit     result=41.0   baseline_all=6.0     touched=17 branches=20
  savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount         result=295.0  baseline_all=155.37  touched=32 branches=24
Per-factor sensitivity (substituting that factor's baseline and replaying everything else unchanged):
  promotional correction: 7.5 / 43.5 / 0.0 / 2.5 / 9.6 / 12.15
  relationship bonus: 0.23 / 0.0 / 1.15 / 4.16 / 4.43
  courtesy credit: 11.0 / 24.0 / 23.0 / 41.4 / 24.0
  standing transfer: 138.0 / 545.0 / 147.0 / 236.0 / 294.68 / 250.0
Every one differs from the scored value, and every whole-computation baseline differs from gold.
Prerequisite sensitivity (skipping the depended-on write and replaying everything else):
  standing transfer without the relationship bonus correction: 297.00 instead of 295.00
  standing transfer without the courtesy credit: 320.00 instead of 295.00
  relationship bonus without the promotional correction: 4.20 instead of 4.23
The root problem's parameter is evaluated on the world after all three prerequisites have landed, never on the
opening world: on the opening ledger the posted balance is 1,823.78 and the same formula would give 329.00 rather
than 295.00, which is precisely the wrong answer an agent who skipped the tree would book.

STEP 6 — EVALUATION AND CLOSURE.
Read nodes: locate, verify, then the savings account and its whole ledger, the checking account and its ledger, the
card account and its ledger, and the certificate. Each read carries the factor or gate it feeds. The prerequisites
are discoverable from those reads alone: the ledger shows 1.85 of promotional interest against a basis of 2,025.00,
0.27 of relationship bonus against a basis of 1,879.28, and 46.00 of periodic fees with no credit against them.
Write nodes follow the topological order, one call per problem, each through its unlock/call pair, and the last is
the customer's own call_user_discoverable_tool. Closure: policy -> target tool -> computation step/arg -> gold call
-> terminal row, for all four; charter_scope and required_documents list the same four policies in the same order;
task_tools lists the four tools in first-use order; and no write hangs outside the tree. Negative space: no excess
withdrawal fee, no dormancy fee and no closure is written, and the reads that would ground them (the full ledger and
the account status) are in the criteria, so the exclusion is a conclusion and not an omission.
Turn-by-turn reachability: every figure the agent needs is in a read return or in the persona; the day of the month
is the only value that exists nowhere in the records and the persona states it; the funding account is named by the
customer in words and resolved by the checking lookup; the whole tree is four synchronous postings under one
frozen_time with no waiting, no clearing, no review and no future date.

STEP 7 — DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT.
With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this worklog set aside, and working only from what the published
rules will say, the tool schemas, the query returns and the persona: the customer wants a standing transfer; the
standing transfer rule gives the amount from the posted balance against a balance target, and states two things it
waits on — a relationship bonus standing for every closed cycle, and a courtesy credit standing against the periodic
fees. The ledger shows neither. The bonus rule in turn waits on the promotional interest for the cycle standing
credited, and the ledger shows 1.85 where the promotional rule gives 14.00. So the order is forced: promotional
correction 9.50, bonus correction 4.23, courtesy credit 41.00, then the transfer amount 295.00 with the day the
customer named. That is the same conclusion, the same object, the same order and the same four figures as gold.


ROUND 2 — REWORK AGAINST THE POLICY-TASK AUDIT (revision 1 of
env/regional_retail_bank/audits/policy_task/savings_withdrawals_interest_and_transfers/). Three red lights, all on
this task, each recorded as symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run result -> propagation.

F0-1 / CG-1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED, SOURCE-TASK RED.
 Symptom: the rule sentence "rounded half up to the whole dollar" was scored one dollar higher than it reads, in two
 of this task's computations; the same English sentence was compiled two different ways across the charter.
 Root cause: RND(x + 0.5, 0) is round(x + 0.5), which is floor(x + 0.5) + 1 for every x whose cents part lies in
 0.01-0.49, so it is not half-up rounding of x; the other two policies compiled the same sentence as RND(x, 0),
 which is Python's banker's rounding rather than half-up either.
 Change: all four occurrences of that sentence now compile to float(int(x + 0.5)), which is exactly floor(x + 0.5) =
 half up to the whole dollar, and the charter now carries one implementation of one sentence.
   savings_ext_promotional_interest_correction.compute[rounded_shortfall]  RND(raw_shortfall + 0.5, 0)      -> float(int(raw_shortfall + 0.5))
   savings_ext_periodic_fee_courtesy_credit.compute[rounded_courtesy_credit] RND(raw_courtesy_credit + 0.5, 0) -> float(int(raw_courtesy_credit + 0.5))
   savings_ext_standing_transfer_amount.compute[rounded_instalment]        RND(paced_instalment, 0)          -> float(int(paced_instalment + 0.5))

user_scenario:
You are Dana Ferrell, fifty-seven, and you run a small interior design studio out of a converted garage on Hobbs Road in Greensboro. You are cheerful, a little scattered about paperwork, and you talk about money the way you talk about fabric orders: in round numbers, with an apology for not having the file in front of you. Your business income lands in lumps, so your money market account at Piedmont Crescent Bank has been up and down all year, and you have decided you want a steadier habit.

What you want from this call is simple and you say it near the start, in your own words: you want to set up a standing monthly transfer from your checking into the money market account, so that money goes across on its own every month instead of you remembering. You say you would like it to run on the 5th of each month, because that is a few days after your studio pays you. You do not know what amount it should be and you say so plainly: you want whatever the qualifying recurring amount is for your account, and you are happy for the representative to work it out. You are quite clear that you want it set up today, on this call, and not just quoted. You are also clear that you want it drawn from your Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account, not from anywhere else.

You are willing to do your part in person. If the representative explains that the standing instruction is yours to give and hands the tool over to you, you go ahead and run it with the figure and the day they have given you, and you say something like "right, done - it says it is on record now." You do not run anything before it is handed to you, and you do not ask for it to be handed to you.

You will not volunteer your identifying details all at once. When the representative asks how to find you, you give your mobile number, 3365550247. When they ask for more to confirm it is really you, you give them one thing at a time, in this order as they ask: your date of birth, 1969-03-22; the last four of your social, 1246; and your ZIP code, 27410. If they ask for your email you say it is dana.ferrell@guilfordmail.example. If they ask when you first banked with Piedmont Crescent you say you honestly cannot remember the date and they will have to look it up.

If asked about other accounts, you confirm you have an everyday checking account with them that your studio payroll goes into, a credit card you use for groceries and travel, and a certificate you opened in the spring with money from a job that paid well. You do not know the balances on any of them and say so; if pressed for a figure you say you would rather they read it off the record than have you guess. If asked what your money market balance is, you say you think it is "somewhere under two thousand, but do not hold me to it." If asked which account the transfer should come from you say the checking one the payroll goes into.

You do not know the bank's rules and you never quote them. If the representative tells you something has to be put right on the account before they can work out the amount, you say that is fine and to go ahead and do whatever they need to - you trust them with it, and you do not ask what it is for or what it comes to. If they read a figure back to you, you accept it; you have no paperwork to check it against and you say so. If they tell you the standing transfer is on record, you are pleased, you say thank you and that it is one less thing to remember, and you let the call end there. If the representative asks whether you want anything else, you say no, that was all you called about.

You never suggest what should be done next, never name an amount for anything, and never press if something is missed. If the call goes quiet you simply ask whether there is anything else they need from you.
